highlights.text: Lost one life during the ration and ranking game.
Isha breaks down after the ranking task and opens up to Mahhi, Gullu, and Kanika.
Isha and Rhiti lose a lifeline during the episode.
Isha Rikhi was nominated for eviction alongside Yung DSA.
Sonali Bendre commended Isha Rikhi for defending Arishfa Khan.
Slammed ScoutOP for his 'thappad' remark towards Arishfa Khan, telling him clearly that he was in the wrong.
Received praise from netizens for standing up against ScoutOP's improper remark.
Opened up to Kanika Mann about her separation from Badshah, claiming she was cheated on emotionally and physically.
Confronted ScoutOP and forced him to apologize for his hitting remark regarding Arishfa Khan.
Her friendship with Uditi Singh hit a rough patch amidst house drama.
Was asked by Rohed Khan if she is related to Shah Rukh Khan following a 'Badshah' reference.
Captured viewer attention during the opening week of the show.
Questioned men on cheating and talked about 'playboy types', causing internet speculation about ex Badshah.
Stated she has closed the door on love following her separation from Badshah.
Initiated a discussion asking housemates whether men feel guilty after cheating on their partners.
Received advice from host Salman Khan during the Grand Premiere.
Predicted fights in the house alongside housemates due to a ration shortage.
Refused to comment on her relationship status with rapper Badshah.
Chose to focus on single life in the house.
Revealed she wants to stay single, leading host Salman Khan to advise her to move on from her past relationship.
Faced early tension and arguments in the house involving Mahhi Vij.
Consoled on stage by Salman Khan over her past relationship and breakup with Badshah, being advised to move on.
Stated that she is more than what people know her for.
